import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix sex label variant (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    
    # Fix body_mass_g: remove commas, convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Fix out_of_range body_mass_g (set to NaN)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric, set out-of-range to NaN
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
